title: When is the Ellis semigroup a complete conjugacy invariant?
summary: The Ellis semigroup of a topological dynamical system contains algebraic, topological and dynamical information. It is invariant under conjugacy. Despite this wealth of structure, two non-conjugate dynamical systems can have the same Ellis semigroup. We identify a class of minimal dynamical systems inside which this cannot happen, that is, for which the Ellis semigroup is a complete conjugacy invariant.
